query: How does combat work in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33?
expected_answer: Combat in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is turn-based, allowing players to perform melee attacks, use items, shoot enemies, or activate skills. During enemy turns, players can dodge, parry, or jump in real time to avoid damage. A stamina system enables breaking enemies, and characters have unique mechanics such as elemental Stains, Stances, magical cards, and Perfection ranks.

query: Who developed Hollow Knight and when was it released?
expected_answer: Hollow Knight was developed and published by the Australian independent studio Team Cherry. It was released for Windows on February 24, 2017, later for Linux and macOS the same year, and for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One in 2018.
